`final class NodeWatchEvent<N extends Node>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeEvent<N>`](/reference/events/nodeevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeWatchEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeWatchEvent.java)

The event of `onWatch`, which fires after a watch of a node applied its properties.

## Description

[`Node.watch`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-method-watch) applies its properties each time its signal changes, then fires [`Node.onWatch`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onWatch).
